_readme: Edit this file to update the app. Everything here is visible to players. Keep secrets in your notes app. IDs must be lowercase, no spaces. Ties only need to be entered ONCE (on either person) - the app draws them both ways.

villagers.name: Fadrian
villagers.notes: Son of Thadrin. Rides a horse named Gordo.

villagers.name: Stevwin
villagers.notes: Likes to hit things. Works the village smithy under Erham.

villagers.name: Snook Anook
villagers.notes: Goes by Anook. Originally from Gordin's Delve, not Stonetop.

villagers.name: Tall Pup
villagers.notes: Raised in the wild. Carries a faint memory of a dark figure and little else of her childhood. Follows Fadrian and learned from him.

villagers.name: Gerhild
villagers.notes: Wife of Berkhard. Works alongside Sithe.

villagers.name: Sithē
villagers.notes: An old, larger woman who walks with a crooked cane.

villagers.name: Alwyn
villagers.notes: A stout and jovial man who takes pleasure in providing community, rest, and mirth through food and drink.

villagers.name: Erham
villagers.notes: A man of few words. The locals find his grunts and mumbles intelligible enough.

villagers.name: Pete
villagers.notes: Jovial. Loves food and drink. An excellent cook.

map.credit: Map by Jeremy Strandberg, from the Stonetop corebook.

locations.name: The Stone
locations.notes: The Stone is well over 50 feet tall and etched in faded runes. It seems older than even the Maker-ruins (page 264) upon which the village was founded. When storms roll in, lightning strikes the Stone repeatedly. This phenomenon has made the locals somewhat impervious to sudden loud sound.

locations.name: The Public House
locations.notes: The public house is a large hall, where folks meet after sundown to drink and socialize. It offers floor space to travelers and a small stable under the same roof. The town’s horses are kept here.

locations.name: The Cistern
locations.notes: The Cistern is an underground vault, clearly an artifact of the Makers. Locals fill it with rain, snow, and water from the Stream (page 396).

locations.name: The Granary
locations.notes: The granary is a warehouse built on a Maker-ruin foundation. Foodstuffs are stored here. Everyone contributes, everyone shares.

locations.name: The Pavilion of the Gods
locations.notes: The pavilion of the gods is an open air structure with shrines to Aratis (page 22), Danu (page 64), Helior (page 224), Tor (page 452), and maybe others (page 178). As close as Stonetop gets to a temple.

locations.name: Berkhard's House
locations.notes: Where Berkhard dwells with his wife, Gerhild

locations.name: The Barracks
locations.notes: Gathering place of the local guard. Weapons and armor are housed here.

locations.name: Snook Anook & Library
locations.notes: Where Snook Anook dwells with many a book and lost arcana.

locations.name: Fadrian and Tallpup
locations.notes: The shared abode of Fadrian and Tallpup.

locations.name: Healing Houses
locations.notes: Home to Sithé and her apprentices. The town's sick or wounded are housed here temporarily.
